.qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r1/task/solution/app/package.json, server.js, src/bootstrap.js, src/db.js, src/index.js (lines 1-70, 200-235, all ORDER BY/now/uid usages), public/index.html, public/js/*.js (grep), src/seed_data.json
evidence:
Verdict basis (workbook Quality Checks!A21:D21 and Internal Quality Checks!A21:D21, no internal annotation in cols E+ for row 20; skill references/quality-checks.md:87-88 '### 20 . solution_is_frozen_and_deterministic: seeding produces the same rows every run; no random ids, no wall-clock-derived values, no boot-time fetch that could move a graded figure; the fixed clock is the only time source the graded rules use').
1) Static committed baseline, nothing generated or fetched: frozen task solution/ holds plain source only (package.json, server.js, src/{bootstrap,db,index}.js, src/seed_data.json, public/{index.html,styles.css,js/app.js,board.js,threads.js}); no build step, bundler, lockfile, node_modules or shipped app.db. solution/solve.sh only verifies no process holds the DB, then 'cp -a "$(dirname "$0")/app/." /app/' and 'rm -f -- "$database_path" ...' (fresh disposable baseline); no npm install, curl or code generation. Deps are exact pins (package.json "better-sqlite3": "12.4.1", "express": "5.1.0") matching the image installs in environment/Dockerfile and tests/Dockerfile (express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1). index.html loads only same-origin /styles.css and /js/*.js; no server-side fetch (grep for fetch( in solution hits only public/js/app.js:29, the same-origin API client). Frozen snapshot is byte-identical to projects/hireops-recruiting-operations/hireops-recruiting-operations (diff -rq empty).
2) Deterministic seeding: src/db.js reads SEED from path.join(__dirname,'seed_data.json') (not CWD); src/seed_data.json sha256 a1c65c80...3740 equals environment/assets/seed_data.json (cmp identical). seedIfEmpty() (db.js) inserts users/jobs/applications/messages/reads/notes in file order inside one transaction, only when the users table is empty; seeded applications get fixed created_at '2026-06-15T09:00:00Z'; messages/notes carry seed created_at (127 messages, 3 notes, none blank; per-thread timestamps strictly increasing for APP-101(120), APP-201(3), APP-301(3), APP-302(1)); read markers resolve deterministically as ids[app][read_count-1] from AUTOINCREMENT ids. Page size 30, stages and candidate labels come from the seed file. No randomness or clock in the seed path.
3) Runtime random/wall-clock use does not touch pinned values: index.js:59 now()=new Date().toISOString() and :60 uid()=p+'-'+crypto.randomBytes(3).hex are used only for records created during grading (jobs :208, applications :226, sessions :88-89, activity/actions/notes/messages created_at). The brief/rules declare no fixed clock and no criterion pins a timestamp or generated id (grep over tests/*/*/judge.toml, prompt.md, app_context.md for clock|timestamp|date|UTC|random|APP-/JOB- ids found none). All graded orderings use explicit position or AUTOINCREMENT id, never wall clock: board 'ORDER BY job_id, stage, position' (:182) and column 'ORDER BY position, id' (:199); activity 'ORDER BY a.id DESC' (:189); threads 'ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?' (:411-412) and 'id>?' (:407); notes 'ORDER BY n.id' (:389). Client time display app.js:21 formats absolute UTC (timeZone 'UTC'), no relative 'x minutes ago'. Session tokens must be random (security) and are not graded values. Generated ids APP-XXXXXX (6 hex) cannot collide with seed ids (APP-101 style).
4) Runtime evidence: qc/runs/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r1/raw-evidence-index.json entries re-hashed: all 6 artifact sha256 match and all 12 matching_source_files hashes match the frozen solution bytes. results/workspace.json (kind 'Scripted golden observations; not a configured judge run', page_errors []) records 26/26 passed, including 'seeded card order and internal notes are loaded' and 'restart keeps jobs, cards, order, messages, unread counts and activity without reseeding'. This is a scripted golden run, not a configured judge/Oracle run; no Oracle or model score is claimed. Determinism of the reference is established from source; this row needs no repeated-run comparison.
Lessons file (handoffs/LESSONS_FROM_COLDERWATER_2026-10-08.md) patterns bearing on row 20: lesson 19 (rerun scripted golden harness after every change) - satisfied for current bytes (hash-matched above); lesson 15 restart/no-reseed - reference guards reseed (seedIfEmpty) and solve.sh resets only at install; lessons 7/14 timing races concern judge prompts, not reference determinism (reference live update is event-driven via SSE plus a 300 ms debounce, app.js:135, criteria allow 15 s). No instance of a listed pattern breaks row 20.
Adversarial: (a) broken reference that could pass: one that reseeds every boot or generates seed rows with random ids/clock - refuted, seed is static and guarded. (b) conforming alternative app that could fail because the reference pinned a nondeterministic value - none found; criteria pin seeded names/stages/counts only.
Notes (non-blocking, P3): candidate applications list is ordered 'ORDER BY created_at, id' (index.js:173), mixing the fixed seed timestamp with wall clock for new cards; with a host clock earlier than 2026-06-15 a new application would list before seeded ones. No criterion grades candidate-list order (hro_candidate_view requires all appear with title/team/status). Also, the session-start git status shows these solution files modified/deleted but not committed to git HEAD; the frozen/package bytes are the static baseline under review, so this is a bookkeeping note (commit before packaging), not a determinism defect.
